summary: set_stats records or accumulates custom stats per host or globally for the run; they only display if show_custom_stats or ANSIBLE_SHOW_CUSTOM_STATS is enabled.
questions: How do I show custom statistics at the end of a playbook run?
Why don't my set_stats values appear in the output?
Can I track counters across hosts in a run?

answer_card.title: Custom run stats with set_stats
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.set_stats` sets/aggregates custom stats per host or for all hosts. To display them, set `show_custom_stats = true` in `[defaults]` or `ANSIBLE_SHOW_CUSTOM_STATS=true`. Works on Windows.
